notes: Duration stated as 7 semesters = 3.5 years. Tuition: the programme pages state USD per semester (English page) / US$ per semester (apply.pte.hu); semester counts were computed with the pages' own semester figures. Deadlines: two sources give different values; the programme-specific deadline from the English site (30 May 2027) was used as applicationDeadline, the apply.pte.hu general deadline (15 Jun 2027) is not used because it is not stated as being for non-EU applicants. The documents list is general (all programmes) with the apply.pte.hu programme page adding the mandatory motivation letter and the note that entry qualification documents are accepted in English. Translation: the apply.pte.hu page states official translations are needed if the school cannot provide a suitable transcript in English; no quote states translation is required for a specific document alone. Language proficiency: no level or test list is given, only 'Language requirements English', hence certificateRequired null. English is the teaching language of the programme (quotes present).
